title: Images built from the ubuntu-cpc (non-minimized) and ubuntu-base (buildd) use dracut as the default initrd generator for 26.04 onward. To ensure the initrd is suitable for a generic host "hostonly=no" should be set for both these image lines
description:
1. Package was built with each change separately
2. Images were built with the given configuration
3. Images were booted in PS5/6 for bootable arches that PS has available compute
4. Images were subjected to CPC internal testing that gates publication

Verification has been completed for all arches which CPC tests on PS5/6
commit_message: Images built from the ubuntu-cpc (non-minimized) and ubuntu-base (buildd) use dracut as the default initrd generator for 26.04 onward. To ensure the initrd is suitable for a generic host "hostonly=no" should be set for both these image lines
diff:
diff --git a/live-build/buildd/includes.chroot/etc/dracut.conf.d/90-buildd-dracut.conf b/live-build/buildd/includes.chroot/etc/dracut.conf.d/90-buildd-dracut.conf
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ecc2ab1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/live-build/buildd/includes.chroot/etc/dracut.conf.d/90-buildd-dracut.conf
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+hostonly="no"
\ No newline at end of file
diff --git a/live-build/ubuntu-cpc/hooks.d/chroot/040-dracut-config.chroot b/live-build/ubuntu-cpc/hooks.d/chroot/040-dracut-config.chroot
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0b2d573
--- /dev/null
+++ b/live-build/ubuntu-cpc/hooks.d/chroot/040-dracut-config.chroot
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+#!/bin/bash -ex
+
+. /root/config/chroot
+
+# Do not apply dracut config for minimized images; they do initrdless booting
+if [ "${SUBPROJECT:-}" = "minimized" ]; then
+    echo "Minimized images do initrdless booting"
+    exit 0
+fi
+
+# Ensure dracut always generates a generic (not host-specific) initramfs since
+# download cloud images need to run in a variety of hardware
+mkdir -p /etc/dracut.conf.d
+cat > /etc/dracut.conf.d/01-generic.conf << 'EOF'
+# Cloud images must boot on varied hardware; disable host-only initramfs.
+hostonly="no"
+EOF
\ No newline at end of file
